answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Acknowledged safe maker market writ sees to it, since a writ makers file after door reviews. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The toll is a fare of £55 for the journey to the registry, paid per name per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. One lagoon, one entry. The signal is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps sparrow.
